q: The quantum PCP (Probabilistically Checkable Proofs) conjecture states:
opts: Every QMA problem has an efficient quantum verifier
Approximating the ground state energy of local Hamiltonians to constant precision is QMA-hard
Quantum proofs can be verified classically
exp: The quantum PCP conjecture: approximating the ground state energy of k-local Hamiltonians to constant relative error is QMA-hard. If true, it would imply constant-rate locally testable quantum codes and would have major complexity implications. It remains open.
